definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:1066 + the lem_PQ_Hilb display, definitional content): when P=Q the abbreviations Co_P, S_P are used; if dim S_P = 1, P is a one-dimensional delta-projection; for Q one-dimensional, S_{P,Q} carries the inner product of display lem_PQ_Hilb (the claim that it IS a Hilbert space must be re-proved, only the defining display is cited).
